title: Athanor Runtime Configuration
description: JSON Schema for athanor.json — the Athanor runtime configuration file at the project root. Root is permissive (additionalProperties: true) so user installs may add unknown fields without validation errors; sub-objects with known shape are strict (additionalProperties: false) but always permit a `_doc` string sibling that acts as inline schema documentation.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URL — release-tag-pinned per CONTRIBUTING.md §Release URL bump.

version.description: Configuration schema version (e.g. "1.0"). Not the plugin version.

_doc.description: Free-form inline documentation for the root config object.

enabled.description: Whether the Codex CLI cross-model planner is invoked when available.

fallback.description: Strategy when codex CLI is unavailable or disabled by config.

maxRetries.description: Max ralph-loop iterations per subtask before circuit breaker engages.

consecutiveFailures.description: Threshold of consecutive subtask failures that trips the breaker.

action.description: Action taken when the circuit breaker trips.

waveSize.description: Max parallel workers per wave in team mode.

discoveryRelay.description: Whether previous wave discoveries are injected into next wave prompts.

decayDays.description: Working lesson decay window in days.

promotionThreshold.description: Access count required to auto-promote a working lesson to permanent.

maxAgeDays.description: Session retention window in days before the cleaner removes them.

models.description: DEPRECATED — slated for removal in v0.7.9. This block is not currently read by any dispatch site; model assignment is hardcoded in skills/<name>/SKILL.md and agents/*.md. See CHANGELOG v0.7.7 deprecation notice.

hooks.description: Stop hook configuration. As of v0.7.8, profile is honored at runtime by scripts/hooks/stop_verify_claims.py. As of v0.7.9, stopLoopThreshold caps consecutive-block loops.

profile.description: Stop hook gate mode: 'off' disables the gate (script exits 0 silently); 'standard' (default) enables full material-claim detection. Unknown values fall back to standard with a stderr warning at runtime. 'lenient' and 'strict' are not yet supported (deferred per plan §10).

stopLoopThreshold.description: v0.7.9+: Max consecutive exit-2 blocks per session before the circuit breaker opens and the (N+1)th invocation releases (exit 0). Prevents infinite gate loops when the verification skill misbehaves. Default 3 if missing. Set higher to be more strict, lower to release faster on suspected misconfiguration.

lenses.description: Default lenses dispatched in parallel by /athanor:review.

minConfidence.description: Confidence-rubric threshold for suppressing low-signal findings during consolidation.
